redraw.1: Redraw this exact slot machine symbol, keeping its design, colours, shape and pose, in crisp high-detail glossy casino slot game art.
redraw.2: A bold new take on this slot machine symbol: same subject and colour scheme, same level of detail.

art_prompts.bust: a slot machine character portrait in a bold painted style like premium mobile casino slot art: a thin dark ink outline around the figure, smooth soft painted shading, light glossy highlights, no cross-hatching. Head and shoulders, facing the viewer, the shoulders wide and cut off flat at the bottom edge of the image, the head in the upper half. Maintain the original facial features and skin tone.
art_prompts.special: a slot machine special-symbol emblem in bold premium casino slot art: one striking badge or icon of the theme, glossy, rim-lit, rich fine detail. No lettering, no words, no numbers.
art_prompts.royal: Repaint this card-rank symbol as premium glossy casino slot art: keep the exact character shape, thickness, size, position and colour; give it a bevelled edge, glossy highlights, rich shading and rim light, theme it to Star Trek Voyager.

voyager-lcars.name: Voyager LCARS
voyager-lcars.note: Mike's brief: an LCARS interface like the modern LCARS phone mockup, glassy with light-blue highlights. Navy frosted glass over the bridge, steel-blue and pale-teal elbows wrapping the reels and side panels, amber only for the registry and Buy Bonus, StarTrek Film on every word. Readouts and the stardate tick in the band under the meters (y 86-106), the only free chrome that the panels' contents never move into.

brief.text: Redesign the whole screen as an LCARS interface: glass-like, with light-blue highlighting, the vibe of the modern LCARS phone mockup (reference). Keep the structure (reels in the middle, jackpots on top, bonus on the right, random features on the left) but make the feel different. The slot's font (StarTrek Film) should carry over to the text on the scene. The image model can do text now, so the logo can use it.

logo.style: glowing light-blue LCARS lettering, crisp edges, a soft cyan glow and a frosted-glass sheen, like a starship display

rules: Wild stands in for everything except Bonus scatter and Free-spins scatter. Pays left to right on 25 lines; the longest match on each line pays.
Random features can hit any spin, some before the reels stop and some after.
3+ Bonus scatter: RED ALERT or DELTA QUADRANT, at random. 3+ Free-spins scatter: 3 combo free games. Buy Bonus (45x the bet): RED ALERT or DELTA QUADRANT, at ra
Upgrades: A, K → EMH · Q, J → Tuvok · Janeway, Seven, TranswarpConduit → Wormhole · EMH → TranswarpConduit · Tuvok → Seven
